notes: The original source archive remains unchanged. Only a build copy replaces pkg_resources version lookup with importlib.metadata, with original and result SHA-256 checks.
The private dependency closure adds no resource IDs and changes no global Python environment or existing wheel pins.
Source installs create fresh venvs with copied interpreters and never invoke online pip or share installation trees.
The tested native scope is the unmodified upstream API/CLI matrix plus known-answer sequential/parallel reductions, one-minimality, invalid input and independent source-install removal.
This build adds a real installed binary envelope with prefix-relative CLI entry points; the exact interpreter base and private wheel identities remain prerequisites.
Use the explicit bin/picire or runtime/bin/python entry points. Shell activation scripts are retained as build-generated reference and are not part of the relocated interface contract.
Native dependency wheels are preserved as precompiled dependencies; the Picire target is built from its original source with the retained compatibility patch.
